tasks.short: Collect and microscopically study blood samples

steps.what: Verify the blood study request and patient and specimen identity requirements
Collect and identify the blood sample under the applicable procedure
Prepare the blood specimen and microscope materials for the requested study
Study blood cells or compatibility findings using the applicable microscopic techniques
Record actual counts, morphology or compatibility observations in the existing laboratory worksheet
Check recorded findings against the specimen and observation worksheet

tasks.design: Use a native request view and the existing specimen worksheet in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system. The technologist collects, prepares and studies the specimen, separately records actual findings and checks them; no automated morphology or transfusion decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Request navigation and stable specimen context are repeatedly handled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native laboratory request and worksheet fields can preserve that context.
tasks.still_hard: Specimen quality and microscopic findings need technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertain or clinically important findings and follow the laboratory procedure.
tasks.altitude: Reduce specimen-record repetition while retaining the laboratory study.

reach.learn: Keep observed evidence and specimen identity traceable

evidence.claim: Native request and worksheet context reuse can reduce record handling; no task-specific microscopic analysis saving is established.

assumptions: The worksheet is the existing laboratory record of the study, used for checking and subsequent result handling. No additional activity log is added and no result release or blood issue is implied.

The technologist verifies patient and request identifiers in s1-s2, produces specimen and findings in s2-s4, and captures actual counts or findings in s5. Capture and ordinary saves remain within eight retained recording hours; uncertain identifiers or findings stop for manual resolution.
The native request view removes 1 of 10 navigation hours. Reusable specimen and method headings remove 2 of 10 worksheet-writing hours; substantive findings and all physical technique remain human.
Ordinary author saves have no self-approval gate. No analyser feed, automated alert or external result send is named.
research_questions: Does native worksheet context remove actual repeated entry after identity and finding checks?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual study findings

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, requested collection and applicable procedure verified in s1 and at collection; changes require renewed identity and procedure checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=97, gross 3 less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5 net. Already reused specimen fields retaining all lookup and 9.5 recording hours have their saving offset by upkeep. Compatible worksheet context retaining 9.5 lookup and 8.5 recording hours plus other 80 and 0.5 upkeep yields 1.5 net. Collection, microscopy and finding checks remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish and monitor laboratory quality assurance

steps.what: Review quality-control observations, method performance and current laboratory requirements
Determine appropriate quality assurance criteria and monitoring coverage
Write quality assurance criteria and monitoring instructions in the existing program document
Compare quality-control observations with the written monitoring criteria
Interpret quality comparisons and determine appropriate investigation or program changes
Write quality findings and required program changes in the existing quality record

tasks.design: Use native quality views in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system, existing program structure in {DOCS} and fixed comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}. The technologist establishes the criteria and interprets comparisons; the rules produce drafts without releasing results, issuing alerts or changing live instruments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual evidence navigation, repeated document structure and fixed comparisons consume quality work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and transparent spreadsheet rules can assist these distinct operations.
tasks.still_hard: A failed comparison does not establish the cause or the appropriate clinical response.
tasks.human_edge: Judge method performance and determine appropriate investigation.
tasks.altitude: Move repeated quality comparison work into transparent rules.

reach.learn: Separate comparison output from investigation and release decisions

evidence.claim: The Canadian laboratory middleware case demonstrates rule-based laboratory verification, but its results do not establish savings for local quality-program design.

assumptions: The program and quality review are existing records used to manage laboratory accuracy. No new activity log is added. The priced comparison work is currently manual, not analyser runtime.

The technologist verifies control identifier, method, lot, measurement date, observed value and units in s1 and produces criterion, limit and applicable method fields in s2-s3. All capture is inside 16 evidence and 17 specification hours; missing fields or incompatible units require manual comparison.

The evidence view removes 4 of 20 navigation hours; existing program structure removes 3 of 20 specification-writing hours; stable review headings remove 1 of 10 review-writing hours. These are different operations with separately sized cuts.

Rules only calculate draft comparisons. Live criterion deployment, result release and any external or internal notification are not named actions in this design; ordinary author record saves remain retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether comparison work is already automated
Completeness and unit consistency of existing control records
research_questions: Do transparent comparisons reduce total review work after data reconciliation and investigation?

already_counted.description: Verify source evidence and interpret quality comparisons

incremental.description: Maintain and challenge comparison rules and field mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=77, gross 23 less 3 upkeep gives 20 net. Conservative case: comparisons already automated and control metadata needs full manual review; only three hours of document structure are removed and offset by upkeep. Compatible records retaining 18 evidence, 18 specification, 5 comparison-exception and 8 review-writing hours plus 20 criteria judgement, 15 interpretation and 3 upkeep yield 13 net. Existing runtime is never counted as eligible labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise, direct and train laboratory staff

steps.what: Review current laboratory procedures, work needs and staff competence records
Assign appropriate laboratory duties and identify training needs
outputs: chosen duty allocation and training needs

steps.what: Write the duty allocation in the existing laboratory work plan
inputs: chosen duty allocation and training needs

steps.what: Communicate assigned laboratory duties and training arrangements to staff
Train laboratory staff through explanation and demonstration of applicable testing procedures
Supervise actual laboratory practice and judge staff performance and assistance needs
Enter completed training and observed competence in the existing staff training record

tasks.design: Use current procedure references in {DOCS}, a reusable work-plan layout and existing training fields in {LMS}. Separate assignment choice, its written allocation and communication from later training, observation and completion entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure navigation and stable work-plan and training fields repeat handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and record formats can preserve those stable fields.
tasks.still_hard: Practical competence must be observed and cannot be inferred from course completion.
tasks.human_edge: Coach staff and judge whether they can perform the testing safely.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated supervision records without replacing training.

reach.learn: Distinguish training delivered from demonstrated capability

evidence.claim: Native procedure references, work-plan layouts and staff training fields can reduce repeated handling; local savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: The work allocation and staff training record already support daily laboratory staffing and competence follow-up. No log of every coaching remark is added.

The technologist verifies procedure version and current staff competence in s1, produces allocation in s2, captures it in s3, observes performance in s6 and captures actual completion and competence evidence in s7. All capture is counted; unclear competence remains manually unresolved rather than inferred.

Procedure links remove 2 of 10 preparation hours; work-plan headings remove 1 of 10 allocation-writing hours; reusable course and staff fields remove 1.5 of 10 completion-entry hours. Each cut reflects different repeated context.
Communication is s4 and fully retained. Ordinary same-system author saves in s3 and s7 remain included without approval. No automatic qualification or staff notification is implied.
research_questions: Does native reuse remove repeated context while retaining actual observation and competence evidence?

already_counted.description: Capture allocation and later observed training completion

incremental.description: Maintain procedure links and record headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact allocation, training arrangements and staff recipient set from the checked s3 version; changed duties or recipients require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 less 1 upkeep gives 3.5 net. Incompatible training fields and already direct procedures retain all lookup and completion entry, leaving one allocation hour removed and offset by upkeep. Usable links and headings retaining 9 preparation, 9.5 allocation and 8.5 completion hours plus other 70 and 1 upkeep yield 2 net. Assignment judgement, communication, training and supervision remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide technical test-result information to permitted recipients

steps.what: Retrieve test results, method context and permitted recipient details
Determine the appropriate technical explanation and limitations of the results
Write the technical result explanation using the existing laboratory response format
Check the final response's values, units, limitations and permitted recipients
Send the checked technical response to permitted clinicians within the organization
Send the checked technical response to permitted family or external professionals
steps.handoff_to: permitted family member or external professional

steps.what: Answer permitted family or external researcher questions about the technical information
steps.handoff_to: permitted family member or external researcher

tasks.design: Use a native result context view in {OTHER}, the laboratory information system, and the existing response layout in {DOCS}. The technologist chooses and writes the technical content, checks the final version, and separately communicates it through the current approved channel; no new clinical interpretation is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Result navigation and reconstruction of stable technical response context repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and reusable method, unit and report headings can preserve stable content.
tasks.still_hard: The appropriate explanation and disclosure depend on the result and recipient.
tasks.human_edge: Explain limitations accurately without implying a diagnosis beyond the evidence.

reach.learn: Keep method limitations distinct from clinical conclusions

evidence.claim: Native laboratory context views and reusable technical response layouts can reduce handling; local savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Written technical replies are an existing output of these requests. No separate communication log or duplicate summary is added. Internal and external sends are separate aggregate routes, not two sends required for every request.

The technologist verifies specimen identifier, result version, value, unit, method and recipient permission in s1, produces explanation in s2 and captures actual reply content in s3. Capture stays in 19.5 retained writing hours; missing units or permissions stop for manual resolution.

The result view removes 5 of 25 retrieval hours. Reusing stable method descriptions, unit headings and response structure removes 10.5 of 30 composition hours; result-specific explanation and limitations remain human.
All sends and questions remain fully retained. The gates attach to actual disclosures and exact final versions, not ordinary same-system author saves.
unknowns: Share of technical responses with reusable method context
Current response format and approved channel
research_questions: Does response-context reuse reduce total composition after value, unit and disclosure checking?

already_counted.description: Compose actual technical explanation and check the final response

incremental.description: Maintain method context, response headings and recipient-channel references

approvals.approved_version: Exact response version, result identifiers and internal clinician recipients checked in s4; edits or recipient changes invalidate the check
Exact response version and permitted external recipient set checked in s4; edits or disclosure changes invalidate the check
Exact technical answer disclosed to the verified permitted current caller within result limitations; changed recipient or content requires reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=84.5, gross 15.5 less 2 upkeep gives 13.5 net. Unusual methods and incompatible result metadata retain all 25 retrieval and 28 writing hours, with the two-hour saving offset by upkeep. Comparable methods retaining 22 retrieval and 22 writing hours plus other 45 and 2 upkeep yield 9 net. Technical judgement, final checking, real sends and questions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain specimen work, technical judgement and staff supervision while reducing existing laboratory record repetition.
reach: Make laboratory evidence and technical limitations traceable
Separate staff competence from training attendance
skills_to_grow: Use native specimen and result context
Separate record writing from clinical and staff interaction
role.ambitious_version: A technologist with clearer quality evidence and less repeated record handling who personally studies specimens, coaches staff and explains result limitations.
